liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- Attendee says 1/10/79 brought Dark Star back to the East Coast, with an outstanding St. Stephen as well [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Bob Weir - Jerry's sick**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-11-25.aud.anderson.85058.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 1 songs; 1 min; rated 2.78/5 by 9 [1]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls lights off, then Weir and Mickey announcing Garcia was on a respirator; crowd reacted with concern, no booing [4]
- After the cancellation, reviewer and friends went to a nearby corner bar featuring an impromptu Elvis impersonator [4]
- Teenage attendee had a stolen ticket replaced at will call, then got an 11th-row center ticket from someone unable to attend the make-up [8]
- Attendee recalls lights coming on and Weir saying Jerry was very sick and the band couldn't play; fans went home early [9]
- Reviewer notes that a cancellation due to bad news about Garcia's condition would have been unsettling, and that some may have heard reports beforehand [10]
- Show was canceled; recording captures Weir announcing it would be rescheduled because of Garcia's illness [1]
- Promoter Jim Koplick is heard offering to validate parking [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-11-25.aud.anderson.85058.flac16**: taped by Jim Anderson; transferred by Rob Berger; source: akg d200e's> Sony TC-158 [1]
